name: 04_gap_severity_and_signal
description: Determines remediation severity, priority bucket, and supportive warm-tone framing for every gap.

rules._description: RTO >= MTPD is always critical before digitalization
rules.out_tone: "Your planned recovery time equals or exceeds the longest outage your team can absorb—let's put a practical manual fallback or faster restore path in place first."

rules._description: Contradicted safeguard on High/Very High protection asset
rules.out_tone: "Your policy document already calls for this safeguard, while daily reality or recent notes show it isn't enforced yet—closing this gap protects high-value operations quickly."

rules._description: Contradicted safeguard on Normal protection asset
rules.out_tone: "Written guidance and day-to-day reality differ here; a small operational adjustment or policy clarification aligns both cleanly."

rules._description: Critical rule gap with Very High CIA inheritance
rules.out_tone: "This dependency carries a Very High protection need—let's resolve ownership and core safeguards before expanding digital interfaces."

rules._description: Critical rule gap on Normal/High/unknown asset
rules.out_tone: "An essential control or structural link is still missing—here is a practical, step-by-step way to address it with your team."

rules._description: Partial gap or unconfirmed document claim
rules.out_tone: "You have partial coverage or a written claim—confirming how it works in day-to-day practice will make your baseline audit-ready."

rules._description: Document claim not yet confirmed by lived reality
rules.out_tone: "A document mentions this safeguard, so we logged it as a claim—take a moment during review to confirm staff actually use it."
"This area is in good shape—keep reviewing it periodically as part of normal operations."
